hh_ethnologue_comment.comment: Southern Rincon Zapotec [zsr] is listed as a separate language from Rincón Zapotec [zar]. No specific localities are given in the Southern Rincon Zapotec [zsr] entry but localities corresponding to the map location of Southern Rincon Zapotec [zsr] are listed in **hh:sd:Earl:Zapoteco-Rincon**:iv as ``easily intelligible'' with those of the Rincón Zapotec [zar] entry (cf.~also **hh:g:Sonnenschein:San-Bartolome-Zoogocho-Zapotec:2004**:4-8). See also: Rincón Zapotec [zar].
